title: rhobound version --json
description: What `rhobound version --json` and `rhobound-mcp version --json` print, as one canonical JSON line: the binary's name and version, and what the go command recorded in it (docs/BUILD.md, DEPLOY_AWS.md 14). Plain `version` prints `NAME VERSION` instead.

version.description: the version set at link time (-ldflags "-X main.Version=..."), else the built-in development version

go.description: the Go release the binary was built with

goarch.description: the architecture the binary was built for (GOARCH)

vcs.description: the source the binary was built from; absent when the go command recorded no revision (a build outside a git checkout, or with -buildvcs=false)

modified.description: true when the checkout had uncommitted changes
